summary: Healthcare Realty Trust filed an 8-K to disclose that it filed a new automatic shelf registration statement on Form S-3ASR to replace its prior one, along with a prospectus supplement relating to an at-the-market equity offering of up to $1,000,000,000 of Class A common stock under existing equity distribution agreements with multiple dealers. No shares were sold under the ATM program prior to the replacement. This is a routine shelf and ATM program update, not a special situation.
